item.title: Consistent fly tipping n, 17th August
item.description:
I’m writing to urgently report persistent fly-tipping right next to my front door, leaning directly on my flat. This has been going on for ages, and despite previous reports, no action has been taken. Every morning, I wake up to new rubbish—from bulky items to general waste. This is now leading to pest problems in my flat. I pay my council taxes, and I expect prompt action. I request that CCTV cameras be installed as soon as possible to identify those responsible. Please treat this with the urgency it demands, as I am facing a serious health hazard. I kindly request a response within 7 days, or I will escalate this further.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Gerards Close, Bermondsey, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
